notes.title: Nautical Survival is coming to early access! 🦈
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860990/Nautical_Survival/

[h3]AHOY, MATEYS![/h3]
[b]NAUTICAL SURVIVAL[/b] is my upcoming survivor-like auto-shooter set in a vast, unforgiving ocean. Command a heavily armed vessel, navigate through treacherous waters, and fend off relentless hordes of sea monsters. Upgrade your seacraft, equip it with weapons and hire crew members to your aid.​

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] High replayability and unlockable content
[*] A variety of possible builds and playstyles
[*] Action-packed naval experience[/list]
[i][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860990/Nautical_Survival/]TRY OUT THE DEMO AND DROP ME A WISHLIST, WONCHA?[/url][/h3][/i]
[h3]Why Wishlist?
[/h3][list]
[*] Get notified on launch day
[*] Be the first to try out new updates and features
[*] Support the development of the game!
[/list]
Thank you,
Idan
